headline: Sky ban Kanter Freedom from arena after clash with Cloud
description: Chicago Sky owner Michael Alter said Enes Kanter Freedom has been banned from Wintrust Arena after showing he has the potential to be a threat when he was tossed from a game Sunday for a verbal altercation with a Sky player.

description: Angel Reese set a WNBA record with 26 rebounds in the Dream's 78-71 win over the Sparks on Monday, pushing her past the league's season record in the same game.

headline: Angel Reese breaks WNBA single-game and season rebounding records as Dream beat Sparks 78-71
description: — Angel Reese broke the WNBA single-game rebounding record with 26 while also breaking the league's season record for rebounds as the Atlanta Dream beat the Los Angeles Sparks 78-71 on Monday night.

headline: Sources: Kanter Freedom not WNBA-eligible; arena ban TBD

headline: Mercury buy out DeWanna Bonner, who will seek title chance
description: The Mercury and DeWanna Bonner have reached an agreement to buy out her contract. Once she clears waivers, the six-time All-Star will look for a chance to sign as a free agent with a playoff team.

headline: Austin scores career-high 31, Mystics rally from 14-point deficit and beat Fire 105-100
description: — Shakira Austin had a career-high 31 points and 10 rebounds and Georgia Amoore hit two free throws with 4.2 seconds left to help the Washington Mystics rally from a 14-point deficit and beat the Portland Fire 105-100 on Sunday night.

headline: Kanter Freedom ejected after confrontation with Sky's Cloud
description: Ex-NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom was ejected from Sunday's game between the Fever and the Sky after a verbal altercation with Chicago's Natasha Cloud.

headline: Caitlin Clark scores 37 points as the Fever beat the Sky 113-90
description: — Caitlin Clark scored 37 points and Kelsey Mitchell had 30, helping the Indiana Fever pull away from the Chicago Sky for a 113-90 victory on Sunday night.
